key_parts.question: What is the current ECB deposit facility rate, and since when has it been in effect?

answer.question: What is the current ECB deposit facility rate, and since when has it been in effect?
answer.answer: As of 2026-11-19, the ECB deposit facility rate is 2.50%, and it has been in effect since 2026-09-16 [ecb_ecb_deposit_facility_rate].

chunks.text:
# ECB deposit facility rate

Source: ECB Data Portal, series FM/B.U2.EUR.4F.KR.DFR.LEV (Deposit facility - date of changes (raw data) - Level).

As of 2026-11-19, the ECB deposit facility rate is 2.50% (in effect since 2026-09-16).

Recent changes:
- 2026-09-16: 2.50%
- 2026-06-17: 2.25%
- 2025-06-11: 2.00%
- 2025-04-23: 2.25%

# France household deposit rate up to 1 year

Source: ECB Data Portal, series MIR/M.FR.B.L22.F.R.A.2250.EUR.N (Bank interest rates on deposits from households with agreed maturity of up to one year (new business)).

The latest available value of the bank interest rate on household deposits up to one year in France (new business), for 2026-09, is 2.54%.

- 2026-08: 2.36%
- 2026-07: 2.38%
